newsitem.title: USA: Rubin repeats support for strong dollar.
newsitem.headline: Rubin repeats support for strong dollar.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Monday reiterated the U.S. support for a strong dollar.

"We believe in a strong dollar, and we will not use the dollar as an instrument of trade policy," Rubin said when asked by a reporter about the U.S. currency. He spoke to reporters after receiving a Finance Minister of the Year award from Euromoney publication.
Earlier on Monday, the U.S. Commerce Department reported that August new home sales soared 4.7 percent.

When asked about the housing data, Rubin noted that monthly figures jump around a lot. However, he said his view that the U.S. economy is healthy and is on a track of solid growth and low inflation has not changed.
Rubin added that in speaking with his business contacts he did not get any sense that they perceived inflation to be heating up.
